dossier.researchSummary: Verified primary-source items from the provided findings: (1) The Hugging Face repository nvidia/Cosmos3-Super contains a model card and a config.json which sets model_name to "nvidia/Cosmos3-Super-Reasoner" and references a Qwen3-VL-32B config and an S3 backbone_path; (2) the NGC catalog listing describes a Cosmos3 Reasoner container for Physical AI/robotics that returns coherent text responses from multimodal inputs and notes licensing under OpenMDW 1.1 and NVIDIA container terms. Primary evidence in the provided findings does not contain an immutable upstream checkpoint hash or revision matching the Forge suffix 'e2bbd9dcb7', does not publish tokenizer/vocabulary details for the Reasoner, does not list canonical input-file format MIME types or exact preprocessing pipelines, and does not publish numeric benchmark tables for the exact Super Reasoner checkpoint. Where primary evidence is absent in the provided findings, explicit evidence-gap statements are included in the dossier.
